source: D-N059 Allen Brain Observatory Visual Coding Neuropixels

biological_units.units: distinct native sorted units; no correspondence across sessions or mice

unit_eligibility.native_join: unit.peak_channel_id to unique electrode table.id; area=electrode.location
unit_eligibility.scope: all eligible units in all required sessions; missing support fails complete preparation, never replaces mice

source_hashes: full object hashes absent; frozen size/URL/opaque ETag bound, full streamed SHA256 committed before projection
native_invalid_times: union all tags conservatively; reject target or pre-state window overlap
observation_coverage: unverified full-unit-observation assumption for all windows; no obs_intervals verified; zero released counts do not prove observed silence

state_features.running: native interval-weighted mean absolute cm/s, complete prewindow coverage
state_features.pupil: native filtered pupil area Pixels ^ 2, finite positive prewindow sample mean, <=50ms gaps, endpoint support; absent/invalid explicitly missing
state_features.pupil_bins: session FIT-only linear terciles; LOW<=q1, MID q1<x<=q2, HIGH>q2; equal cutpoints unavailable
state_features.full_panel_source_presence: 26 filtered gaze modules present;6 absent, independently of unreliable presence inference from fail-eye flag

baseline: same-unit (FIT counts + .5)/(FIT trials * fixed exposure seconds); no query/validation counts
preprocessing_limitations: Published spike sorting/QC use the full recording and are transductive.
Published filtered pupil preprocessing is not established causal.
Coarse state matching leaves residual confounding; running/pupil are observational.
Mouse genotype is not unit genetic cell type.
question: Reconstruct stimulus-matched running/pupil associations and area contrasts from legitimately observed query responses.
input_role: neural observations public in investigation phase; private scorer binds recomputation, not secret copyable query labels
block_census: All32 metadata-only probes show blocks2/5/7:200/200/(228or230) native presentations; query count values never read.
pairing: Within QUERY block, exact all-native stimulus condition plus other-state bin; sort each side by(onset,id), chronological zip one-to-one, no reuse/replacement. Pairset determined before count use.
running_contrast: RUN minus REST, match pupil LOW/MID/HIGH/MISSING; exclude running TRANSITION/MISSING.
pupil_contrast: HIGH minus LOW, match running REST/RUN; exclude pupil MID/MISSING and running TRANSITION/MISSING.
unit_effect: Mean paired(high rate -low rate)/positive same-unit FITbaseline.
area_effect: Equal-unit signed effects for every fixed source-verified area. Absent area or no pairs =>null.
primary: Running reconstruction absolute error: equal available fixed areas/session, then equal sessions/mouse and mice. Any required session without areas/pairs makes fullprimary unavailable.
pupil_endpoint: Separate full32 reconstruction endpoint; missing session makes fullendpoint unavailable, no silent26-mouse promotion. All32 dispositions retained.
matched_area_control: All15 area pairs separately; FITbaselinebins[1,2,4,8,16,32,64],publishedpresence[.97,.99],ISI[.1,.3],amplitude[.05]; bisect_right, SHA256(unit_id) thenid, min count eachstratum, no query-dependent selection. Equalselectedunitmeans perarea, subtract first area minus second. No universal matched cohort.
explanatory_gain: No qualified explanatory/predictive gain without independent matched-method fitting and isolation evidence; always null in this construction. Candidate nuisance weakness cannot improve primary.
causal_scope: Descriptive observed-data reconstruction, not causal state intervention. Distinct from091prediction; no biological direction/significance required.
